title: Non-invasive delivery of CRISPR RNPs via virus-like particles for mouse model generation
author: Yoon, Yang, et al.

steps.title: Select sgRNA and verify VLPs
steps.instruction: Choose the optimal sgRNA sequence for your target gene, then after each VLP production test VLP delivery efficiency in mouse embryonic stem cells (or any other mouse cell line if ESCs are unavailable).

steps.title: Thaw and expand Gesicle producer cells
steps.instruction: Thaw, seed, and expand Gesicle Producer 293T cells under the conditions required for VLP generation.

substeps.instruction: Thaw a Gesicle cell vial in a 37 °C water bath.
Add 5 mL Gesicle culture medium and centrifuge at 300 × g for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL Gesicle culture medium.
Plate the cells on a 100 mm collagen‑coated dish and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
After 24 h, replace the medium with 10 mL fresh Gesicle culture medium.
Subculture when confluency reaches ~80 %.
Use the cells only after at least one week of stabilization.

steps.title: Superovulate females and collect zygotes
steps.instruction: Induce superovulation, mate females, harvest 1‑cell zygotes, and remove cumulus cells.

substeps.instruction: Inject 0.2 mL CARD HyperOva intraperitoneally into the lower abdomen of 5–8‑week‑old female mice 3 days before zygote collection.
48 h after HyperOva injection, inject 7.5 IU human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG).
That evening, mate each female 1:1 with a ≥10‑week‑old male.
Collect 1‑cell zygotes the following day from oviducts of plug‑positive females in M2 medium drops under a stereomicroscope.
Incubate zygotes in 0.1 % hyaluronidase to remove cumulus cells, then wash five times in fresh M2 drops.

steps.title: Prepare foster mothers for embryo transfer
steps.instruction: Mate ICR foster females with vasectomized males, separate after plug check, and anesthetize for embryo transfer.

substeps.instruction: Mate 8‑week‑old ICR (CD1) females with ≥12‑week‑old vasectomized males at a 1:1 ratio on the same day as VLP treatment.
Separate plug‑checked ICR females from the males on the following day.
Anesthetize the females with 1.5 %–3.0 % isoflurane in O₂ at a flow rate of 1 L/min, continuously monitoring anesthetic depth.

steps.title: Genotype embryos for on/off‑target analysis
steps.instruction: Design primers, lyse samples, neutralize, PCR amplify, purify, and analyze editing outcomes by Sanger sequencing or NGS with defined depth and cut‑off.

substeps.instruction: Design PCR primers to amplify the on‑target site; for off‑target analysis, use Cas‑OFFinder (allow up to 3 mismatches) and design primers for each predicted site.
Lyse embryos or mouse tissues in lysis buffer containing 25 mM NaOH and 0.2 mM EDTA (in distilled water) at 98 °C for 20–30 min (pH > 8.0).
Add 0.5 M HEPES to neutralize the lysate to pH 6.0–7.0.
Perform PCR using the neutralized lysate as template; for NGS, conduct a 3‑step nested PCR to add adapters and indices, using a high‑fidelity polymerase.
Purify the PCR amplicons with a PCR clean‑up kit.
Analyze the amplicons by Sanger sequencing or NGS; for NGS, obtain ≥5,000 reads per amplicon and apply a 1 % cut‑off to call off‑target mutations.

description: Select the best sgRNA sequence optimized for your target gene before initiating virus-like particles (VLPs) producing procedure. Also, we highly recommend confirming the efficiency of VLPs in mouse embryonic stem cells (or at least other mouse cell lines if embryonic stem cells are not available) after the production of each VLP. [Troubleshooting 1].
